== Pointers ==
[[File:Pointers example.jpg|thumb|600x600px|Code for today]]
View image to the right

<nowiki>*</nowiki>p gives the value at location p (p->1709->7)

p gives the value of the location (1709)

&p gives its own memory location (1712)

x gives 7

<nowiki>*</nowiki>x gives the value at location 7 (x->7->location(7))

* only works if x is declared as a pointer

&x gives memory location of content (1709)
